summary: Chande Momentum Oscillator: net up moves versus down moves over 9 bars, from -100 to +100, with levels at plus and minus 50.
overview: The Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO) measures momentum on a scale from -100 to +100 in its own pane. Overbought and oversold levels sit at +50 and -50 by default.
The line and fill are green while momentum is positive and red while negative.
how: Over the last 9 bars, add all up moves (Su) and all down moves (Sd) of the source. CMO = 100 x (Su - Sd) / (Su + Sd).
Unlike RSI it uses raw sums without smoothing, so it reacts quickly.
use: Some traders watch moves beyond +50 or -50 as stretched conditions.
Use zero-line crosses to see changes in momentum direction.
Look for divergence between CMO and price at swing points.
Use its absolute value as a measure of trend strength.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
Short lengths make it jumpy; longer ones smooth it.
